summary: Exec discovery with Lucia Fernandez (Director of Engineering) and Diego Alvarez (Search Tech Lead). Two pains: marketplace search relevance is plateauing (conversion flat 4 quarters) and Datadog spend just crossed $6M/year. Currently split: Solr for legacy product search + Elasticsearch for newer surfaces. Want one platform with native vector for semantic search. Datadog renews September 1. Board mandate is 30% cost reduction. Decision criteria: search latency p99 under 80ms at 10x current QPS, observability ingest cost down 30%, conversion lift of 2% on semantic-relevance pilot. Lucia sponsors, CTO signs, architecture council reviews. Diego is technical champion. Decision Q3 2026.
